LightningComponentBundle.description: Stacked bar chart of daily cumulative macro distribution (Carbs, Fat, Protein) as % of total grams per logged day.

property.name: daysToShow
property.label: Days to show
property.description: Number of recent days (including today) to chart.

property.name: theme
property.label: Theme
property.description: Dark = SLDS navy (matches a dark dashboard); Light = white (matches a report chart).

property.name: chartTitle
property.label: Chart title
property.description: Heading shown above the chart. Leave blank to hide it (e.g. when a dashboard supplies its own title).
